objective: Tap, double tap, long press, swipes, Explore-3D drag-rotate, pinch and touch-cancel behave as a phone user expects.
device: Generic phone profile 390×844, DPR 2, hasTouch, isMobile

steps.action: Open the cataract page; tap Start; wait for ready
One-finger vertical swipe starting on the 3D canvas
steps.expected: The page scrolls; the canvas does not trap the gesture

steps.action: One-finger horizontal swipe on the canvas (Explore 3D off)
steps.expected: Camera does not move (view unchanged) and the page does not scroll sideways
No page zoom (visual viewport scale stays 1) and no playback change

steps.action: Tap "Explore 3D", then drag horizontally on the canvas
steps.expected: Explore mode on (aria-pressed=true); the drag rotates the model; the page does not scroll

steps.action: Pinch out with two fingers in Explore mode
steps.expected: The model zooms (view changes); the page itself does not zoom

steps.action: Explore mode: start a drag on the "Labels" tool button and slide across the canvas
steps.expected: Starting on a control does not rotate the camera

steps.action: Tap "Done exploring"; tap Play / Next / Previous
steps.expected: Playback buttons work and none of them rotates the camera by itself (only stage fly-to)

steps.action: Check nothing overlays the 3D controls in the free screen area
steps.expected: Each visible control is the top element at its own centre (no overlay swallows the tap)

steps.action: Long press (700 ms) on a related-procedure link, then lift
steps.expected: The site does not hijack long press: the browser’s own contextmenu is not cancelled and no script handles the press (what follows — menu or tap — is browser-defined; headless Chromium has no context menu)
steps.actual: contextmenu events=0 (cancelled by page: 0); then headless Chromium treated the release as a tap and navigated (emulation behaviour; went Back)

steps.action: Touch start on a link, then the touch is cancelled (e.g. incoming call)

steps.expected: Navigates (sanity check that taps still work after the cancelled touch)

steps.action: Vision simulator: horizontal swipe on the viewer (no compare)
steps.expected: Nothing happens to the page (no sideways scroll); vertical swipe still scrolls

steps.action: Vision simulator: tap the "Compare" switch label and drag the divider; vertical swipe on the divider
steps.expected: Divider follows a horizontal drag; a vertical swipe on it does not move it a lot
wa.me link with a prefilled message, opened in a new tab (intercepted, nothing sent)
